meta.title: Amira Bechini
meta.description: Filmed masterclasses in brow architecture, lash couture and permanent makeup by Amira Bechini. Study at your pace, certify when you are ready.

hero.sub: Nine years of atelier practice, filmed lesson by lesson. Study at your pace, certify when you are ready.
hero.portrait: Amira Bechini at work in her Milan atelier

instructor.title: Amira Bechini
instructor.body1: Amira trained in Tunis, refined her pigment work in Paris, and opened her Milan atelier in 2017. Her waiting list runs eleven months.
instructor.body2: She teaches the way she works: slow mapping, restrained pigment, and a healed result that still reads as skin two years later.

credentials.one: Certified in permanent makeup by the Italian Society of Aesthetic Medicine
credentials.two: Editorial work for Vogue Italia and Marie Claire Arabia
credentials.three: Trains 40 artists a year, in person and on this platform

method.title: How the lessons are built
method.sub: Every course follows the same three movements, so nothing is skipped and nothing is guessed.

one.title: Read the face
one.body: Bone structure, asymmetry, skin behaviour. Mapping decisions before a single stroke.

two.title: Work the pigment
two.body: Filmed in close macro, both hands visible, at the speed you would actually work.

three.title: Heal and correct
three.body: What the result looks like at day 7, day 30, month 18, and how to fix each outcome.

catalog.title: Four courses, one standard
catalog.sub: Buy a single course or work through all four. Access does not expire.

brow-architecture.title: Brow Architecture
brow-architecture.tagline: Mapping, hair stroke, and the shape that survives healing
brow-architecture.description: The full brow system, from reading bone structure to the second retouch. Nine hours of macro footage, filmed on six different skin types.

outcomes.one: Map a brow that suits the face rather than the trend
outcomes.two: Lay hair strokes with consistent depth and no blowout
outcomes.three: Correct grey and orange healed work without a laser

lash-couture.title: Lash Couture
lash-couture.tagline: Classic, volume and mega volume, with retention that holds
lash-couture.description: Seven hours on isolation, fan making and adhesive control. The course spends as long on retention as it does on application.

outcomes.one: Build fans by hand at speed without adhesive pooling
outcomes.two: Diagnose why a set drops in week two and stop it
outcomes.three: Remove a set cleanly with no damage to the natural lash

permanent-makeup.title: Permanent Makeup Foundations
permanent-makeup.tagline: Lip blush, eyeliner and colour correction, start to finish
permanent-makeup.description: Fourteen hours across skin science, hygiene, device handling and three signature techniques. The longest course in the catalogue.

outcomes.one: Choose pigment by undertone rather than by swatch
outcomes.two: Run a lip blush session end to end, including numbing
outcomes.three: Recognise and manage complications before they scar

atelier-business.title: The Atelier Business
atelier-business.tagline: Pricing, portfolio and the client journey behind a full book
atelier-business.description: Six hours on the part nobody films. How Amira prices, photographs and rebooks, with the real numbers from her own studio.

outcomes.one: Price on outcome and chair time instead of guesswork
outcomes.two: Shoot healed results that read honestly on a phone
outcomes.three: Build a rebooking system that fills next quarter

lessons.lip-blush: Lip blush from outline to saturation
lessons.complications: Complications and when to refer out
lessons.client-journey: The client journey, first message to rebook
lessons.scaling: Adding a second pair of hands

one.quote: I stopped guessing at pigment. My healed results finally look like the ones in my portfolio.
one.name: Ghita Benslimane

two.quote: The retention module alone paid for the course in three weeks of rebookings.
two.name: Sofia Marchetti

three.quote: Amira films at the speed you actually work. No cuts hiding the difficult part.
three.name: Camille Dorval

four.quote: I raised my prices by 40 percent and lost two clients. I gained eleven.
four.name: Yasmine Trabelsi

one.q: How long do I keep access?
one.a: Access does not expire. You buy the course once and it stays in your studio, including any lessons added later.

two.a: The foundations module of every course assumes none. If you already practise, start at the technique module.

three.a: It certifies completion of this masterclass. Licensing rules for permanent makeup vary by country, so check your local regulator before you practise.

four.a: The platform and every lesson are available in English, Italian, French and Arabic.

five.a: Yes. Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay and three-part instalments are all available at checkout.

six.q: What if the course is not for me?
six.a: Write within fourteen days, before you pass a quarter of the lessons, and you get a full refund.
